static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.family_status: 与一只宠物猫同住，Mother曾是Nurse
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可倾诉，但难以与他们讨论自己的not够好感受；与同事关系因对赞美的轻视而紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred before; has not received psychotherapy; no notable physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能回顾具体事件；配合度高；自述紧张但抱有希望；能识do not并描述自动化思维与认知模式；愿意尝试策略

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于negate积极评论和赞美，尤其是来自工作中上司的，这导致自卑感并削弱我的自信心。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到not断negate正面反馈影响了我的自尊和工作满意度，因此寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 在一次为一对情侣拍摄的摄影中，Zhu Li在not yet保存图像前误格式化了存储卡，导致所有照片丢失；尽管对方非常理解，她仍强烈感到自己辜负了对方和自己。自那次事件后，与摄影和烘焙相关的负面自我评价与恐惧增强，开拍或准备下厨前常被“我会再搞砸”的想法困扰，并逐渐回避这些原本喜欢的活动。
约六个月前开始在咖啡馆担任服务员工作，频繁在收到上司或同事的赞美后出现“这not重要/not真诚”的解释，将正面反馈视为not值一提，逐步影响工作表现、同事关系以及日常心情与动机。

special_situations.event: The boss praised the shirt she hand-sewed that morning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果赞美来自not被我视为“专家”的人，就not具备价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立即negate或缩小赞美的意义，过滤掉积极信息
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她not是时尚达人，她的认可not算数，这并not说明我有能力

special_situations.event: Receiving praise from colleagues or customers at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果正面反馈not够专业或具体，就可能是not真诚或只是客套，因此not值得采纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将赞美归为客套话并淡化其意义，逐渐与同事疏远或Relationship tension
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是随口说说，并not真心

special_situations.event: Before starting a photography session or preparing to bake
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I made one serious mistake before, it means I will always fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过回避摄影/烘焙或在开始前not断Self-denial来“预防”失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又会搞砸，I am a failure

special_situations.event: Facing social interactions with friends or colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我感觉自己not够好，那就说明我真的not够好，应该避免接触以免被看出问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing互动，减少与同伴交流

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be genuinely recognized and affirmed, to receive sincere appreciation from others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次失败或被negate，担心他人的赞美not真诚从而暴露自己的not够好
defense_goal: 通过deny赞美与Intellectualization他人的肯定来降低Anxiety
保持一定疏离与Avoids socializing以避免被评判

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易犯错的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: not专业、赞美not可信的评价者（如上司/同事/他人）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give affirmation or emphasize his success experiences in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识认为这些肯定not真诚或not专业（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻声、谨慎地表示怀疑，提出对方“not够专业”等理由，避免直接接受肯定；语气保留，减少情感外露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the photography mistake is discussed or one's ability is questioned
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以一次错误推断整体能力not足，用“专业性标准”等理性框架来回避痛苦情绪（移情：Intellectualization）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use专业术语或标准化语言解释为何赞美not可靠，语气冷静克制，尽量not谈感受。

日常烹饪与园艺的Decreased motivation
outcomes: 兴趣降低与not满足感上升

难以与朋友讨论自己的not够好感受

manifestations: 在会谈与工作情境中将他人的赞美解释为not真诚或not重要
Believes others are just 'being polite' rather than truly recognizing

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly self-critical before starting photography or baking, repeatedly presuming failure
Overly critical of her own performance when interacting with colleagues and reduces contact

positive_force: 过往多数摄影与烘焙经历取得Good结果，具备真实能力与经验
Has tried self-regulation strategies such as deep breathing and walking
Actively seeks professional help; positive attitude toward counseling
negative_force: 倾向negate正面反馈，外部验证依赖失衡
Mental filtering and overgeneralization, tending to only see the negative and predict failure
Low sense of self-worth、强烈自我批评
Social avoidance导致Relationship tension与支持减少

antecedent: Receives praise / commendation from supervisors, colleagues, or customers at work
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次严重失误被内化为“I am a failure”，并将非专业来源的赞美视为without效或not重要
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible judgment and disappointment, maintaining self-protection and controllability in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、Tense relationships with colleagues、Lowered self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: 在开始摄影或烘焙前的灾难化Anxiety与负面预测
target_behavior.core_reason: One mistake is overgeneralized into 'I will always fail', with negative predictions
target_behavior.function: 通过预设失败降低not确定性与Anxiety的not可控感，避免投入
target_behavior.consequence: Avoids or reduces participation, finds it hard to enjoy activities, confidence damaged

antecedent: 与朋友或同事约见或交流前
target_behavior.core_reason: 情绪化推理与Self-denial（感觉not够好→认为not够好）
target_behavior.function: 避免可能的评价或尴尬，短期降低Social anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、Increased sense of isolation、支持系统弱化
